verses.text: It is verily a great thing to live in obedience, to be under authority, and not to be at our own disposal.
verses.modernizedText: It is truly a great thing to live in obedience, to be under authority, and not to be at our own disposal.

verses.text: Far safer is it to live in subjection than in a place of authority.
verses.modernizedText: It is far safer to live in subjection than in a place of authority.

verses.text: Many are in obedience from necessity rather than from love; these take it amiss, and repine for small cause.
verses.modernizedText: Many obey from necessity rather than love; they resent it and complain for little reason.

verses.text: Nor will they gain freedom of spirit, unless with all their heart they submit themselves for the love of God.
verses.modernizedText: Nor will they gain freedom of spirit unless they submit themselves with all their heart for the love of God.

verses.text: Though thou run hither and thither, thou wilt not find peace, save in humble subjection to the authority of him who is set over thee.
verses.modernizedText: Though you run here and there, you will not find peace except in humble subjection to the authority of the person set over you.

verses.text: Fancies about places and change of them have deceived many.
verses.modernizedText: Fancies about places and changing them have deceived many.

verses.text: True it is that every man willingly followeth his own bent, and is the more inclined to those who agree with him.
verses.modernizedText: It is true that everyone willingly follows his own inclination and is more drawn to those who agree with him.

verses.text: But if Christ is amongst us, then it is necessary that we sometimes yield up our own opinion for the sake of peace.
verses.modernizedText: But if Christ is among us, then we must sometimes give up our own opinion for the sake of peace.

verses.text: Who is so wise as to have perfect knowledge of all things?
verses.modernizedText: Who is so wise as to have perfect knowledge of all things?

verses.text: Therefore trust not too much to thine own opinion, but be ready also to hear the opinions of others.
verses.modernizedText: Therefore, do not trust too much in your own opinion, but be ready also to hear the opinions of others.

verses.text: Though thine own opinion be good, yet if for the love of God thou foregoest it, and followest that of another, thou shalt the more profit thereby.
verses.modernizedText: Though your own opinion is good, if for the love of God you give it up and follow that of another, you will benefit all the more.

verses.text: Ofttimes I have heard that it is safer to hearken and to receive counsel than to give it.
verses.modernizedText: I have often heard that it is safer to listen and receive counsel than to give it.

verses.text: It may also come to pass that each opinion may be good; but to refuse to hearken to others when reason or occasion requireth it, is a mark of pride or wilfulness.
verses.modernizedText: It may also happen that each opinion is good; but to refuse to listen to others when reason or the occasion requires it is a mark of pride or willfulness.
